cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you.

beats.text: Apparently my test has reached a less comfortable definition of commitment.

mechanism: A tests its former project pupil loyalty through an overnight shift, then uses coaching authority to defend the sleep A will not sacrifice.
confusable: Not merely testing B commitment: B turns the condition back on A and exposes A own protected comfort.
comparison: Overnight work and leadership exemption versus volunteer duty and a reserved seat.
